title: S01 Fixed Three-Port Turnout
description: Original fixed single-sided turnout visual module with three real rail ports, 12 progressively longer timber sleepers, fused same-layer rail geometry, fixed point tie, frog throat and opposite guard rails. The 1.00 m clear gauge and rail-head height Z=.20 m match the existing 2m straight track; inlet (0,-3), straight outlet (0,3), branch outlet (1.64201469,2.99968014) with heading .55 rad from +Y. Head-level flange channels are 40mm wide with recessed web relief; actual imported end faces and finite channel probes are checked. One straight-route parked inspection trolley pose is tested separately. Editable static components only: no switch animation, driving, continuous passage, load or railway safety certification.
